scenes.caption: A tree.
scenes.say: Maryam sits under a tree with a good book.

scenes.caption: Retrieval.
scenes.say: The text says Mina set off at dawn. That is retrieval.

scenes.caption: Inference.
scenes.say: Omar slammed the door. She infers that he was angry.

scenes.caption: Evidence.
scenes.say: She finds a line as evidence. Stomped upstairs proves it.

scenes.caption: Opinion.
scenes.say: The most exciting city is an opinion, not a fact.

scenes.caption: Theme.
scenes.say: The story shows that kindness matters. That is the theme.

scenes.caption: Sound.
scenes.say: Crash! The poem uses a sound word.

scenes.caption: Prediction.
scenes.say: The title is The Last Lantern. What will happen?
